traits.name: Chill Breath
traits.text: ⬻ (cold, evocation, primal); The frost giant breathes out a 15-foot cone of freezing moisture that quickly condenses into ice, dealing 4d6 (4d6) cold damage. Each creature in the cone must attempt a DC 28 basic Reflex save. A creature that fails its save is also immobilized and takes 2d6 (2d6) cold damage at the end of each of its turns until it gets free (Escape DC 28). The giant can't use Chill Breath again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Ice Stride
traits.text: A frost giant isn't impeded by difficult terrain caused by snow or ice, nor does it need to attempt Acrobatics checks to keep from falling on slippery ice.

traits.name: Wide Swing
traits.text: ⬻ The frost giant makes a single greataxe Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes within its reach. This counts as two attacks for the frost giant's multiple attack penalty.
